arxiv-2208-14766.title: Tunable degree of polarization in a Figure-8 fiber laser
arxiv-2208-14766.creator: Banoj Kumar Nayak, Cijy Mathai, Dmitry Panna, Eyal Buks
arxiv-2208-14766.description: Abstract We experimentally study a fiber loop laser in the Figure-8 configuration, and explore the dependency of the degree of polarization on controlled parameters. To account for the experimental observations, a mapping is derived to evaluate the polarization time evolution. Nonlinearity induced by Kerr effect and gain saturation gives rise to rich dynamics.

arxiv-2402-08370.title: Breakup of liquid jets: Thermodynamic perspectives
arxiv-2402-08370.creator: Fei Wang 1,5, Oleg Tschukin 1, Thomas Leisner 3,4, Haodong Zhang 1,5, Britta Nestler 1,2,5
arxiv-2402-08370.description: Abstract Breakup of a liquid jet into a chain of droplets is common in nature and industry. Previous researchers developed profound mathematic and fluid dynamic models to address this breakup phenomenon starting from tiny perturbations. However, the morphological evolution of the jets at large amplitude perturbations is still an open question.

arxiv-2510-19707.title: Open Neighborhood Ideals of Well Totally Dominated Trees are Cohen-Macaulay
arxiv-2510-19707.creator: Jounglag Lim, James Gossell, Keri Ann Sather-Wagstaff, Devin Adams, Vi Anh Nguyen, Suzanna Castro-Tarabulsi, Aayahna Herbert, Yifan Qian, Matthew Schaller, Zoe Zhou, Yuyang Zhuo
arxiv-2510-19707.description: Abstract . We introduce and investigate the open neighborhood ideal 𝒩 ⁡ ( G ) \mathcal{N}(G) of a finite simple graph G G . We describe the minimal primary decomposition of 𝒩 ⁡ ( G ) \mathcal{N}(G) in terms of the minimal total dominating sets (TD-sets) of G G .

arxiv-2512-18654.title: Hierarchical filtrations of vector bundles and birational geometry
arxiv-2512-18654.creator: Rahim Rahmati-asghar
arxiv-2512-18654.description: Abstract . We introduce and systematically study hierarchical filtrations of vector bundles on smooth projective varieties. These are filtrations by saturated subsheaves of equal rank whose successive quotients are torsion sheaves supported in codimension one. The associated numerical invariant, called hierarchical depth , measures the maximal length of such filtrations.

arxiv-2601-14370.title: Hunting the first Cosmic Giants: formation and detectability of Direct Collapse Black Holes around high-redshift quasars 2026 Hunting the first Cosmic Giants: formation and detectability of Direct Collapse Black Holes around high-redshift quasars – 8
arxiv-2601-14370.creator: Alessandro Trinca, Alessandro Lupi, Zoltán Haiman, Marta Volonteri, Rosa Valiante, Raffaella Schneider, Roberto Decarli
arxiv-2601-14370.description: Abstract The rapid emergence of supermassive black holes (SMBHs) in the early Universe poses a challenge to current models of black hole growth. One promising formation pathway is the direct collapse black hole (DCBH) scenario, in which gas in pristine, low-metallicity halos forms supermassive (or quasi-) stars leading to massive black holes seeds under specific environmental conditions.

pmc-10642039.title: Impact of clonal lineages on susceptibility of Staphylococcus lugdunensis to chlorhexidine digluconate and chloride benzalkonium
pmc-10642039.creator: Laurie Destruel, Marine Lecomte, Maxime Grand, Marie Leoz, Martine Pestel-Caron, Sandrine Dahyot
pmc-10642039.description: BackgroundLittle is known about susceptibility of Staphylococcus lugdunensis to antiseptics. The objective of this study was to evaluate, at the molecular and phenotypic level, the susceptibility of 49 clinical S. lugdunensis strains (belonging to the seven clonal complexes [CCs] defined by multilocus sequence typing) to two antiseptics frequently used in healthcare settings (chlorhexidine digluconate [CHX] and chloride benzalkonium [BAC]).

pmc-10737142.title: SOCIAL INTELLIGENCE TRAINING AND CUSTODIAL GRANDFAMILIES: A QUALITATIVE ANALYSIS OF RELATIONSHIPS
pmc-10737142.creator: Megan Dolbin-MacNab, Gregory Smith, Frank Infurna, Britney Webster, Saul Castro, D Max Crowley, Carol Musil
pmc-10737142.description: Custodial grandfamilies often experience relational challenges related to parenting and the grandparent-grandchild relationship that would benefit from intervention. Social intelligence training (SIT), which focuses on improving socio-emotional skills via online, self-guided modules, holds promise for helping grandfamilies address their relational challenges.

pmc-11352300.title: From Pancytopenia to Hyperleukocytosis, an Unexpected Presentation of Immune Reconstitution Inflammatory Syndrome in an Infant with Methylmalonic Acidemia
pmc-11352300.creator: Samuel Sassine, Amandine Remy, Tanguy Demaret, François Proulx, Julie Autmizguine, Fatima Kakkar, Thai Hoa Tran, Caroline Laverdière, Ellery T. Cunan, Catalina Maftei, Grant Mitchell, Hélène Decaluwe, Jade Hindié
pmc-11352300.description: A 2.5-month-old girl admitted for failure to thrive and severe pancytopenia was diagnosed with methylmalonic acidemia (MMA) secondary to transcobalamin II deficiency, an inborn error of vitamin B12 metabolism. Opportunistic Cytomegalovirus and Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia led to severe acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) and immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS) after treatment initiation with vitamin B12 supplementation.

pmc-11472462.title: Hydrogen-Induced Topotactic Phase Transformations of Cobaltite Thin Films
pmc-11472462.creator: Mingzhen Feng, Junjie Li, Shenli Zhang, Alexandre Pofelski, Ralph El Hage, Christoph Klewe, Alpha T N’diaye, Padraic Shafer, Yimei Zhu, Giulia Galli, Ivan K Schuller, Yayoi Takamura
pmc-11472462.description: Manipulating physical properties through ion migration in complex oxide thin films is an emerging research direction to achieve tunable materials for advanced applications. While the reduction of complex oxides has been widely reported, few reports exist on the modulation of physical properties through a direct hydrogenation process.

pmc-11615711.title: Learning Curves for Robotic-Assisted Ventral Hernia Repair
pmc-11615711.creator: Wei San Loh, Ryan A. Howard, Brian T. Fry, Jyothi R. Thumma, Edward C. Norton, Justin B. Dimick, Kyle H. Sheetz
pmc-11615711.description: This cohort study evaluates the learning curves for robotic-assisted ventral hernia repair using data from Medicare fee-for-service patients from 2010 to 2020. Introduction The use of robotic-assisted ventral hernia repair has increased more than any other surgical procedure over the last decade.1 For instance, among Medicare beneficiaries, the proportion of robotic-assisted ventral hernia repairs increased from 0.5% to 13.

pmc-12472876.title: Structural Speciation of Hybrid Ti(IV)-Chrysin Systems—Biological Profiling and Antibacterial, Anti-Inflammatory, and Tissue-Specific Anticancer Activity
pmc-12472876.creator: Sevasti Matsia, Georgios Lazopoulos, Antonios Hatzidimitriou, Athanasios Salifoglou, Fernando Mendes, Adenilson Oliveira dos Santos, Francisco Ferreira De Sousa
pmc-12472876.description: Metal–organic compounds, and especially those containing well-known antioxidant natural flavonoids (Chrysin, Chr) and metal ions (Ti(IV)), attract keen interest for their potential biological activity nutritionally and pharmacologically. To that end, chemical reactivity profiling in binary/ternary systems was investigated synthetically, revealing unique structural correlations between mononuclear (Ti(IV)-Chr) and tetranuclear assemblies (Ti(IV)-Chr-phen).

pmc-13382905.title: Advancing battery failure diagnosis by knowledge-augmented large language models
pmc-13382905.creator: Xin Zhang, Jingling Yuan, Lin Li, Zhaohui Deng, Jinqiao Du, Wen Luo, Liqiang Mai
pmc-13382905.description: Battery failure diagnosis is crucial for ensuring the safety and reliability of energy storage systems. However, existing approaches from electrochemical modeling to deep learning often face limitations, including heavy reliance on extensive training data, poor generalization, and interpretability issues. To address these challenges, we propose BattFailScholar, a knowledge-augmented large language model (LLM) framework for battery failure diagnosis.
